messages.author: fb40a65bd21dcf6f
messages.subject: modular integer arithmetic
parts:
Hi,

Is there anything in Stan for modular integer (or real) arithmetic? I think the following should work for ints:

a - (n * (a/n))

but was wondering if there is anything more succinct?

Thanks,
John.

messages.author: 275b133a3506805a
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] modular integer arithmetic
parts:
fmod() - see stan manual, sec 28.5. Also see the warning in that section...

HTH
Dan

Daniel
